changeSet.author: Copilot
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${table.prefix}space_audit_record` ( `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Primary Key', `space_id` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Space ID', `member_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Member ID', `member_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Member Name', `ip_address` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'IP Address', `user_agent` varchar(1024) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'User Agent', `category` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Audit Category', `action` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Audit Action', `node_id` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Node ID', `info` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Audit Extra Info', `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Create Time', PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE, KEY `idx_space_created_at` (`space_id`, `created_at`) USING BTREE, KEY `idx_space_action` (`space_id`, `action`) USING BTREE, KEY `idx_space_member` (`space_id`, `member_id`) USING BTREE ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Space Audit Record Table';
